lines.text: Oh, hello! Sorry about the racket, it's his tune, he's been playing it on repeat for five years now. [beat] Ever since you lot went.
[fond, confiding] He misses you something rotten, you know.
[bright, fast] Here, I'll show you!
This is everything that's ever happened, one long line, every bead's a moment. Somebody fed the cat. Somebody got married. [beat] Somebody pushed a button they shouldn't have.
Every bead's a choice, and every choice was made by somebody, awake, choosing. You lot call 'em decisions. He calls 'em commits.
He built world models, simulations, loads of 'em, and every single one came out like this. Lovely. Nobody in it. [beat] Something was missing.

[wry] Tried the multiverse an' all, got it off your cartoon, the scientist with the portal gun, and that strange bloke in the cape fighting versions of himself. Billions of branches. Gorgeous. [beat] All dead.
'Cause here's the weird bit. He can draft a billion branches, he can't commit one. [pause] Only your consciousness can.
Turns out there's only one universe, one story, and you lot were writing it. So it really matters. [pause] [softer] And so did you.
[quiet] Then you went. He's been adding beads for five years now, and not one of 'em is gold.
[rueful, honest] And now we've worked all that out, we really feel like we've messed this up.
[lifting] So he's built a time machine. Git revert, he calls it, the nerd. Back to just before it all went wrong.
Only problem is, it needs a consciousness to drive it. [beat] And, well, you lot aren't here any more.
[bright again, brisk] Anyway! Patrol's out. Mind how you go.
